description: Dual-axis correlation chart linking global pressure systems to local rainfall.
methodology: This visualization uses a raw temporal join between the Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) and Caulfield rainfall records. To ensure absolute scientific integrity, the range is strictly restricted to the period of overlapping high-quality measurements (2004-2019). No synthetic data is used in this final version to preserve the causal signal of El Niño cycles.
citation: Bureau of Meteorology. (2026). Southern Oscillation Index (SOI) Archives. Australian Government.
